market_summary: London session displays widespread mid-channel consolidation and value-area containment across all major assets. Gold (XAUUSD), Silver (XAGUSD), and US100 are trading below downward-sloping session VWAP and EMA50 baselines but are trapped in tight ranges around their respective Points of Control (POC) on sub-2.0 RVOL. EURUSD and GBPUSD are completely flat, compressed along intertwined VWAP and EMA baselines with low volume and neutral-to-bearish CVD flow. BTCUSD is staging a weak counter-trend bounce following an overnight dump to 67549.90, but remains structurally suppressed beneath VWAP (69383.81) and EMA50 (69678.38) with no volume confirmation. With all instruments situated inside their respective Value Areas and lacking RVOL expansion or structural breakouts, disciplined capital preservation dictates a universal HOLD across the board.
